reuse.why: Consolidates the existing hidden/group-hidden category query into one helper used by every month-wide action; the saved-template check is a small new parser rather than reusing goal-template's reading, which is acceptable as no exported predicate exists.

duplication.why: Removes three copies of the same SQL and the setZero/copyPreviousMonth variants, replacing them with a single getMonthWideCategories call.

placement.why: The selection helper lives in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use it, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and a release note are touched; single-category actions are untouched.

maintainability.why: Clear single rule definition; minor wrinkles are the extra query in copyPreviousMonth (getBudgetData still selects now-unused hidden columns) and the parse-failure-means-template heuristic.

one_place.where: getMonthWideCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg.
